# CompactArguments

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `CompactArgumentsInspection`

`compact('name')` silently skips (or, since PHP 7.3, warns about) variables
that do not exist at that point. A name that never appeared earlier in the
function is usually a typo or a variable assigned too late.

## Example

```php{10,11,19,30}
<?php
function summary($net, $tax)
{
    $gross = $net + $tax;
    return compact(
        'net',
        "tax",
        'gross',
        'discount',
        'discount',
        '$gross',
        "{$gross}",
        $net
    );
}

function lateAssignment($unit)
{
    $payload = compact('unit', 'count');
    $count = 3;
    return $payload;
}

class Report
{
    public function build()
    {
        $title = 'Q3';
        $render = function () use ($title) {
            return compact('title', 'footer');
        };
        return compact('title', 'render');
    }
}

$top = compact('nothing');
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 10: Variable &#39;$discount&#39; may be undefined when compact() runs.</li>
<li>line 11: Variable &#39;$$gross&#39; may be undefined when compact() runs.</li>
<li>line 19: Variable &#39;$count&#39; may be undefined when compact() runs.</li>
<li>line 30: Variable &#39;$footer&#39; may be undefined when compact() runs.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "CompactArguments": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore CompactArguments

/**
 * @noinspection CompactArgumentsInspection
 */
```
